Below it a small centred heading ("Bellarminus de Offic."), then a block of quotation in italic, then the centred heading "Explicatio.", then a paragraph with margin notes in the left margin. Below that the heading "I. ANIMADVERSIO.", its subtitle, and a paragraph with margin notes in the left margin. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.head: Bellarminus de Offic.
main_text.p: « Dixit (inquis) Bernardus; [Exhibendam esse reue-rentiam summa & Apostolicæ Sedi, & B. Petri Vica-rio, sicut (inquit) ipsam vobis vultu ab vniuerso serua-[?]ri Imperio.] Quorsum hæc? Ex his docetur quæ sit eminentia potestatis Pontificum super potestatem Regum.. — pag. 36.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Bellar. l. 5. de Pont. c. 6. & 7. & 17. cap. 7.{p}Quatenus vero? Vt deponant eos (inquit alibi) quamprimum vires habeant. Sic Bellarminus; ubi personas quatuor commemorat, tanquàm partim Authores, partim Patronos, aut saltem assertores & vindicatores istius. (uti {*}dixit) Eminentis Pontificiæ potestatis supra potestatem Principum terrenorum: Bernardum, Pontificem Petri successorem, Petrum Vicarium Christi, & Petri Dominum: Christum Iesum. A quibus singulis (si accuratius paulo res ipsa pensitetur) Causam Regiam propugnari, Pontificiam verò penitus profligari facilè videbimus.* Supra.
main_text.head: I. ANIMADVERSIO.

head.i: S. Bernardum Potestatis Regiæ Assertorem esse satis lu-culentum.

main_text.p: Massonius in vita Honor. 2.Bernardum ut virum {f}Mirabilem, & veluti quoddam in terris Sydus merito agnoscimus: nam in atra quasi nocte Rom. Ecclesiæ ferè solus effulsit Bernardus, qui tam doctrinæ, quam vitæ suæ lumine, cum in aliis multis, tum in hoc, de fidelitate ergà Reges, dogmate tenebras vestras dispulit. De doctrina {**}accepimus; Praxin experiamur. De hac Baronius historiam prolixam habet. Summa est, {t}Honorium Pont. ob persecutionem à Ludovico Francorum Rege illatam Episcopo Parisiensi, Sanctum Bernardum è Clauftro protraxisse, qui de Causa illa inquireret, & de causa cum Rege pugnaret; ut patet ex Baron. Annal. An. 1143. n. 7. & deinceps.* Supra sect. 17. [?]Epist.

page.notes: Running head is given without "Cap. 5.", which is the chapter number and not part of the title. Marks: "p", "f", "t" and "sect" are in the margin and in the text as printed; their pairing is read from position and is doubtful. The asterisks in the text stand for two separate reference marks, and the first note with "Supra" is read as "Supra." with no section number. The reading "serua-" at the end of the quotation is uncertain (the scan looks like "ferua" or "serua"). "Sect. XV." is a margin marker, not a heading. "Epist." at the foot is taken as the catchword. The printed quotation marks « are kept as printed. The "Baron." note reads "n. 7." as printed.
